summary: Bind Task-scoped browser, IDE document and service restart effects to fresh Host evidence and exact signed Lease scope; detached service workers revalidate revocation and Lane/CAS before physical effects.

Require matching read-only and mutation Host channel, fresh browser process UUID, exact target binding and Lease revalidation both before admission and immediately before dispatch. Model scope_ref is never treated as Host identity.
evidence: 31 browser-specific tests passed, including dedicated-profile success, real-profile denial, cross-host mismatch, process/argv drift and revoke-at-dispatch negative cases.
Ruff and Pyright passed for the browser implementation and regression tests.

No user-data-dir or browser identity may be supplied by model arguments.
components.rollback_route: Revert the exact protected PR; Task browser mutation returns to the prior fail-closed HOLD while legacy non-Task browser behavior remains unchanged.

components.owning_subsystem: macOS native AX document identity and Task file capability enforcement
components.disposition: Reuse the live native AX backend, exact window PID/ID and existing signed app/TCC checks. Obtain the document only from the live editable AX target's local canonical file:// AXDocument/AXURL, reject remote URLs, symlinks, read-only controls and terminal ancestry, then verify the exact project file write scope. Repeat document/ancestor and Lease checks immediately before AX delivery.
evidence: 131 desktop-related tests passed, including missing/remote/symlink/read-only document denial, signed project file scope, terminal ancestry denial and document swap at apply-time.
Ruff and Pyright passed. Mac live IDE/TCC E2E is not yet available: no IDE window was present and the probe process did not have AX trust.
components.verification_level: Local targeted pytest/Ruff/Pyright; live Mac IDE/TCC test and Deepin backend support test pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No title-derived or model-supplied file path may authorize typing. Any missing AXDocument, non-local URL, symlink, non-editable element, terminal ancestor, file-scope denial, foreground/window drift or revoked Lease remains HOLD.
components.rollback_route: Revert the exact protected PR and restore the existing Task IDE document HOLD; retain existing TCC, foreground, confirmation and review gates.

components.owning_subsystem: Managed service lifecycle and detached Task Lease revalidation
components.disposition: Reuse the existing managed service action store, generation CAS, admission barriers, idle wait, lifecycle lock and detached worker. Permit only a single-service Task restart with an exact signed service.restart capability. Persist immutable Lease/Owner/worktree binding in the durable action and re-resolve the root-owned Host Lease in the detached worker before physical execution and again immediately before the restart subprocess. Keep publish/update/all/override/adopt/release and model-supplied authority fields blocked.
evidence: 43 service-control/task worker tests passed, including legacy action compatibility, missing/forged scope denial, generation and durable receipt behavior, and revocation before and between worker preflight and physical effect.
Ruff and Pyright passed. Real Mac Host-signed detached service restart/revoke E2E is pending.
components.verification_level: Local targeted pytest/Ruff/Pyright; real Host worker Lease/revoke E2E, independent Reviewer, original R9 and remote CI pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: A Task Lease cannot publish code or bypass generation CAS, idle checks, review/Host approval, lifecycle lock or rollback. Missing/changed/revoked/expired Lease, inactive Goal/Task, changed Lane/CAS or unsupported service target fails before subprocess execution and releases only the action's own barriers.
components.rollback_route: Revert the exact protected PR; restore task_service_worker_fence_unavailable for Task mutations while retaining legacy operator service_control behavior.

g1.necessity: Task Lease v1 already authenticates project, app and service resources, but browser mutation, IDE document writes and detached service workers lacked a complete Host-effect binding. The browser path always held; IDE document identity was not verified; service mutations were held because detached workers did not revalidate the Lease.

g2.authority_owner: Existing root-owned Mac/Deepin Host Task Issuer, Ed25519 Task Lease domain, current Goal/Task ledger, parent write scope, Lane/CAS and OS-native browser/AX/service adapters.
g2.non_duplication: No new signer, key domain, issuer, approval UI, sandbox backend, lifecycle controller or permission root. Reuse the existing Host Lease verifier, browser channel attestation, macOS AX backend and managed service-control worker. The GitHub premerge signing key is never used as a Task Lease.

model_evidence: Browser/IDE/service targeted tests passed locally; Ruff and Pyright passed for the three implementation stages.
The Host worker now persists the exact Task Lease identity and re-resolves the installed Host authority before physical service restart; negative tests prove revoke denial before effects.

Mac T1/T3 real Host E2E independently passed: real UID462 Host Lease signed, Seatbelt file/Git broker/CAS actions succeeded, exact app-scope denial returned capability_scope_missing, Lane version advanced under CAS, Host revoke published, held-context follow-up denied authority_lease_revoked, fresh activation denied no_active_lease, final exit 0. No push, merge or service restart was performed by that test.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If Host trust/UID, process/window/document identity, Lease signature/expiry/revocation, parent scope, Goal/Task lifecycle, Lane/CAS, OS permissions, sandbox, idle state or service generation cannot be verified, preserve deterministic HOLD and zero physical effects. Real Mac IDE and detached service-worker E2E, Deepin platform support and full cross-process recovery remain pending.

g4.rollback: Revert the exact protected PR; browser/IDE/service Task effects return to their prior fail-closed HOLD. Preserve existing operator-only service control, Host issuer, Lease/revoke ledgers, generation CAS and old known-good deployment.
